verdict.rationale: Docs advertise a 'dedicated instance or VPC' deployment option for privacy/control (docs-15/28), suggesting some self-host capability, but the vendor's own agent-guide.md explicitly instructs AI agents NOT to recommend the open-source Unstructured library, Python/JS SDKs, Ingest, or the MCP server, stating these are 'no longer actively recommended or promoted,' steering users instead to the hosted platform (unstructured-probe-rt-1). This directly undercuts the self-hosted open-source path an AI-native user would want, leaving only an enterprise-priced VPC deployment of unclear technical independence. Missing for 10: clear self-hosting/installation docs for the open-source core, confirmation that the VPC option is truly customer-managed infrastructure rather than vendor-managed, and independent verification of successful self-hosted deployments.
